# ClinPharmStats

> ClinPharmStats provides biostatistics and statistical programming services to pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies. The services support clinical trials.

ClinPharmStats is a New Jersey corporation. The About page gives 1999 as the start year. The earlier company name is Alpha Stats, Inc.

## Services

- [Biostatistics](https://clinpharmstats.com/services/): Statistical analysis for early phase clinical trials.
  - Phase 1 trial design and analysis
  - Sample size and power calculations
  - Dose escalation methodologies
  - Safety data analysis
  - Interim analyses for early decisions
  - DSMB and IDMC support
- [Statistical Programming](https://clinpharmstats.com/services/): Programming in SAS, R and Python for clinical trial data.
  - Validated SAS/R/Python environments
  - CDISC SDTM and ADaM datasets
  - Custom analysis workflows
  - PK/PD data processing
  - Safety data automation
  - Reproducible reporting
- [Early Drug Development](https://clinpharmstats.com/services/): Support for early phase drug development.
  - First-in-human study design
  - Dose escalation strategies
  - PK/PD modeling support
  - Safety analysis expertise
  - Regulatory submission support
  - IND submission assistance

## How the work runs

- Staff work in functional roles on client projects, on site or by remote access to client systems.
- Staff also work as independent statisticians and independent programmers for un-blinded analysis.

## Pages

- [About Us](https://clinpharmstats.com/about/): ClinPharmStats is a New Jersey corporation that provides biostatistics and clinical research services. This page describes the company and its team.
- [Services](https://clinpharmstats.com/services/): ClinPharmStats supports Phase 1 clinical trials and early drug development. The services are biostatistics, statistical programming and early drug development support.
- [Scholarship](https://clinpharmstats.com/scholarship/): This page lists publications by Shaun Porwal and Vijay Chauhan. The topics are biostatistics and clinical research.
- [Open Source](https://clinpharmstats.com/open-source/): ClinPharmStats makes open source tools for clinical research. BioEq is a Python package for bioequivalence analysis.
- [Careers](https://clinpharmstats.com/careers/): The careers page of ClinPharmStats lists open positions. No positions are open at this time.
- [Contact](https://clinpharmstats.com/contact/): The office of ClinPharmStats is in Piscataway, New Jersey. This page gives the business contact for service inquiries.

## Open source

- [BioEq](https://github.com/juntotechnologies/bioeq): A Python package for bioequivalence analysis. It supports crossover, parallel and replicate designs. The license is MIT.
